text:
kai: FYI react-native sample (sdk-js-react-native 0.6.0) is spamming DEBUG logs with user emails during token refresh. Otel context is flipping on retries so logging-level filtering and redaction hook don't line up.

kai: repro steps on iOS simulator:
```
yarn --cwd examples/react-native ios
# tap 'Call API (expire token)'
```

kai: sample stderr:
```
2026-03-28T18:01:02.345Z DEBUG outgoing request user=toni@example.com x-request-id=req-111aaa
2026-03-28T18:01:02.678Z INFO retry attempt=2 x-request-id=req-222bbb
2026-03-28T18:01:03.001Z DEBUG outgoing request user=[REDACTED] x-request-id=req-222bbb
```

anja: are you mounting redactHook before the logger shim? RN packager sometimes hot-reloads and rebinds console.*; if redactHook init is async we get a window where console.debug prints raw data.

rafa: Also curious about level semantics: our RN shim treats DEBUG as verbose and routes to console.debug, but our redactHook only patches console.error/console.warn. We forgot console.debug. That would explain emails in DEBUG logs but not in WARN.

kai: good catch. We register redactHook for error/warn only in RN to avoid perf hit. But for auth refresh flows debug is used heavily.

anja: quick fixes: 1) add console.debug patching to redactHook in the sampleapp (local). 2) force stable attempt id header for retries (`x-rwinternal-req`) so correlation is deterministic. 3) make redactHook install synchronously with a small local ruleset fallback to avoid startup races.

jord: for parity with web and node we should centralize the hook ordering: redactHook first, then logger shim, then otel. Also add an opt-in `redactOnAllLevels` flag so sampleapps can enable wider coverage without perf regression in prod.

otel-bot: Reminder: OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for fetch in RN may create new spans for each retry unless context is explicitly bound. See docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/otel/rn-retries.

rafa: test idea: e2e in detox that triggers expired-token path and asserts stderr has no email regex. Also unit test for console shim verifying all console.* methods are patched.

kai: will open GH issue + PR with: patch sampleapp to patch debug, add local rule fallback, and add retry header retention. Repro env: sdk-js-react-native 0.6.0, react-native 0.72.4, node 20.4.

anja: thanks — label issue `devex, telemetry, dx` and mark as high since this leaks PII in developer builds.

kai: pinging after PR. :thumbsup:
